355: static void mb_uart_tx_cmpl_isr(mb_uart_cb_t *chnl_cb, mb_chnl_ack_t *ack_buf)  /* tx_cmpl_isr */
356: {
357: 	mb_uart_rsp_t * uart_rsp = (mb_uart_rsp_t *)ack_buf;
358: 
359: 	u8      tx_fail = 0;
360: 
361: 	/* chnl_cb->rx_xchg_buff == uart_cmd->cmd_buff. MUST be true. */
362: 
363: 	if( (ack_buf->hdr.cmd != chnl_cb->tx_cmd) || 
364: 		(chnl_cb->tx_in_process == 0) )
365: 	{
366: 		/*
367: 		 *   !!!  FAULT  !!!
368: 		 */
369: 		BK_LOGE(MOD_TAG, "Fault tx_cmd:%x, rsp_cmd:%x\r\n", chnl_cb->tx_cmd, ack_buf->hdr.cmd);
370: 
371: 		return;
372: 	}
373: 
374: 	chnl_cb->status_cts = uart_rsp->uart_rts;
375: 
376: 	if(ack_buf->hdr.state & CHNL_STATE_COM_FAIL)
377: 	{
378: 		tx_fail = 0x01;
379: 	}
380: 	else
381: 	{
382: 		tx_fail = uart_rsp->uart_tx_fail;
383: 	}
384: 
385: 	/* try next Tx. */
386: 
387: 	bk_err_t	ret_val = BK_FAIL;
388: 
389: 	ret_val = mb_uart_send_data(chnl_cb);
390: 
391: 	if(ret_val == BK_OK)
392: 	{
393: 		chnl_cb->tx_state_req = 0;
394: 	}
395: 	else
396: 	{
397: 		if(chnl_cb->tx_state_req)
398: 		{
399: 			ret_val = mb_uart_send_state(chnl_cb);
400: 			
401: 			if(ret_val == BK_OK)
402: 			{
403: 				chnl_cb->tx_state_req = 0;
404: 			}
405: 		}
406: 	}
407: 
408: 	if(ret_val != BK_OK)
409: 	{
410: 		chnl_cb->tx_in_process = 0;  /* clear here, because no tx_cmpl_isr callback! */
411: 	}
412: 
413: 	if(tx_fail)
414: 	{
415: 		// fail handle.
416: 		BK_LOGE(MOD_TAG, "Tx Failed!\r\n");
417: 	}
418: 
419: 	if(chnl_cb->tx_isr_callback != NULL)
420: 	{
421: 		chnl_cb->tx_isr_callback(chnl_cb->tx_isr_param);
422: 	}
423: 
424: 	return;
425: }

480: static bk_err_t mb_uart_send_data(mb_uart_cb_t *chnl_cb)
481: {
482: 	bk_err_t	ret_val = BK_FAIL;
483: 
484: 	u16    rem_len, cpy_len;
485: 	u16    rd_idx, wr_idx;
486: 
487: 	if(chnl_cb->status_cts != 0)
488: 	{
489: 		return BK_ERR_BUSY;
490: 	}
491: 
492: 	rd_idx = chnl_cb->tx_rd_idx;
493: 	wr_idx = chnl_cb->tx_wr_idx;
494: 
495: 	if(rd_idx <= wr_idx)
496: 	{
497: 		cpy_len = wr_idx - rd_idx;
498: 	}
499: 	else
500: 	{
501: 		cpy_len = sizeof(chnl_cb->tx_buf) - (rd_idx - wr_idx);
502: 	}
503: 
504: 	if(cpy_len == 0)
505: 	{
506: 		return BK_FAIL;
507: 	}
508: 
509: 	if(cpy_len > MB_UART_TX_FIFO_LEN)
510: 	{
511: 		cpy_len = MB_UART_TX_FIFO_LEN;
512: 	}
513: 
514: 	if(rd_idx < wr_idx)
515: 	{
516: 		memcpy(chnl_cb->tx_xchg_buff, chnl_cb->tx_buf + rd_idx, cpy_len);
517: 	}
518: 	else
519: 	{
520: 		rem_len = sizeof(chnl_cb->tx_buf) - rd_idx;
521: 
522: 		if(rem_len >= cpy_len)
523: 		{
524: 			memcpy(chnl_cb->tx_xchg_buff, chnl_cb->tx_buf + rd_idx, cpy_len);
525: 		}
526: 		else
527: 		{
528: 			memcpy(chnl_cb->tx_xchg_buff, chnl_cb->tx_buf + rd_idx, rem_len);
529: 
530: 			memcpy(chnl_cb->tx_xchg_buff + rem_len, chnl_cb->tx_buf, cpy_len - rem_len);
531: 		}
532: 	}
533: 
534: 	chnl_cb->tx_cmd = MB_UART_SEND_DATA;
535: 
536: 	mb_uart_cmd_t	uart_cmd;
537: 
538: 	uart_cmd.chnl_hdr.cmd  = MB_UART_SEND_DATA;
539: 	uart_cmd.cmd_buff      = (void *)(chnl_cb->tx_xchg_buff);
540: 	uart_cmd.cmd_data_len  = cpy_len;
541: 	uart_cmd.uart_rts      = chnl_cb->ctrl_rts;
542: 	uart_cmd.resvd         = 0;
543: 	uart_cmd.crc8          = cal_crc8_0x31(chnl_cb->tx_xchg_buff, cpy_len);
544: 
545: 	ret_val = mb_chnl_write(chnl_cb->chnl_id, (mb_chnl_cmd_t *)&uart_cmd);
546: 
547: 	if(ret_val == BK_OK)
548: 	{
549: 		chnl_cb->tx_rd_idx = (rd_idx + cpy_len) % sizeof(chnl_cb->tx_buf);
550: 	}
551: 
552: 	return ret_val;
553: }

628: static u16 mb_uart_write_data(mb_uart_cb_t *chnl_cb, u8 * data_buf, u16 data_len)
629: {
630: 	u16    rem_len, wr_len;
631: 	u16    rd_idx, wr_idx;
632: 	
633: 	rd_idx = chnl_cb->tx_rd_idx;
634: 	wr_idx = chnl_cb->tx_wr_idx;
635: 
636: 	if(rd_idx > wr_idx)
637: 	{
638: 		rem_len = rd_idx - wr_idx - 1;  // always reserved one byte space.
639: 	}
640: 	else
641: 	{
642: 		rem_len = sizeof(chnl_cb->tx_buf) - (wr_idx - rd_idx) - 1;
643: 	}
644: 
645: 	wr_len = data_len;
646: 	if(wr_len > rem_len)
647: 		wr_len = rem_len;
648: 
649: 	if(wr_idx < rd_idx)
650: 	{
651: 		memcpy(chnl_cb->tx_buf + wr_idx, data_buf, wr_len);
652: 	}
653: 	else
654: 	{
655: 		if(rd_idx != 0)
656: 			rem_len = sizeof(chnl_cb->tx_buf) - wr_idx;  // if rx_idx == 0, reserved one byte at tail of the array.
657: 
658: 		if(rem_len >= wr_len)
659: 		{
660: 			memcpy(chnl_cb->tx_buf + wr_idx, data_buf, wr_len);
661: 		}
662: 		else
663: 		{
664: 			memcpy(chnl_cb->tx_buf + wr_idx, data_buf, rem_len);
665: 
666: 			memcpy(chnl_cb->tx_buf, data_buf + rem_len, wr_len - rem_len);
667: 		}
668: 	}
669: 
670: 	chnl_cb->tx_wr_idx = (wr_idx + wr_len) % sizeof(chnl_cb->tx_buf);
671: 
672: 	/* trigger send! */
673: 	mb_uart_send_data_trigger(chnl_cb);
674: 
675: 	return wr_len;
676: }

678: static u16 mb_uart_read_data(mb_uart_cb_t *chnl_cb, u8 * data_buf, u16 buf_len)
679: {
680: 	u16    rem_len, rd_len;
681: 
682: 	if(!chnl_cb->chnl_inited)
683: 		return 0;
684: 
685: 	u16    rd_idx, wr_idx, data_cnt;
686: 
687: 	rd_idx = chnl_cb->rx_rd_idx;
688: 	wr_idx = chnl_cb->rx_wr_idx;
689: 
690: 	if(rd_idx <= wr_idx)
691: 	{
692: 		data_cnt = wr_idx - rd_idx;
693: 	}
694: 	else
695: 	{
696: 		data_cnt = sizeof(chnl_cb->rx_buf) - (rd_idx - wr_idx);
697: 	}
698: 
699: 	rd_len = data_cnt;
700: 	if(rd_len > buf_len)
701: 		rd_len = buf_len;
702: 
703: 	if(rd_len == 0)
704: 	{
705: 		return 0;
706: 	}
707: 
708: 	if(rd_idx < wr_idx)
709: 	{
710: 		memcpy(data_buf, chnl_cb->rx_buf + rd_idx, rd_len);
711: 		chnl_cb->rx_rd_idx += rd_len;
712: 	}
713: 	else
714: 	{
715: 		rem_len = sizeof(chnl_cb->rx_buf) - rd_idx;
716: 
717: 		if(rem_len > rd_len)
718: 		{
719: 			memcpy(data_buf, chnl_cb->rx_buf + rd_idx, rd_len);
720: 			chnl_cb->rx_rd_idx += rd_len;
721: 		}
722: 		else
723: 		{
724: 			memcpy(data_buf, chnl_cb->rx_buf + rd_idx, rem_len);
725: 			if(rem_len < rd_len)
726: 			{
727: 				memcpy(data_buf + rem_len, chnl_cb->rx_buf, rd_len - rem_len);
728: 			}
729: 
730: 			chnl_cb->rx_rd_idx = rd_len - rem_len;
731: 		}
732: 	}
733: 
734: 	data_cnt -= rd_len;
735: 
736: 	/* rts assert...... */
737: 	if(data_cnt < ((sizeof(chnl_cb->rx_buf) - 1 - MB_UART_RX_FIFO_LEN) * 8 / 10))
738: 	{
739: 		if( chnl_cb->ctrl_rts != 0)
740: 		{
741: 			chnl_cb->ctrl_rts = 0;
742: 			mb_uart_send_state_trigger(chnl_cb);
743: 		}
744: 	}
745: 
746: 	return rd_len;
747: 
748: }

+#!/bin/sh
+
+set -eu
+
+csv=${1:?ram_regions.csv path required}
+
+if [ ! -r "$csv" ]; then
+  printf '%s\n' "BK7258 SWAP layout: cannot read $csv" >&2
+  exit 1
+fi
+
+result=$(awk -F, '
+  BEGIN { base = 0x28000000; found = 0 }
+  /^[[:space:]]*#/ { next }
+  /^[[:space:]]*PSRAM_CAPCAITY_SIZE/ { next }
+  NF >= 4 {
+    name = $1
+    type = $2
+    offset = $3
+    size = $4
+    gsub(/[[:space:]]/, "", name)
+    gsub(/[[:space:]]/, "", type)
+    gsub(/[[:space:]]/, "", offset)
+    gsub(/[[:space:]]/, "", size)
+    if (type != "SRAM") next
+    if (offset != "") base = strtonum(offset)
+    bytes = strtonum(size)
+    if (name == "SWAP") {
+      printf "0x%08x 0x%08x\n", base, bytes
+      found = 1
+    }
+    base += bytes
+  }
+  END { if (!found) exit 2 }
+' "$csv")
+
+if [ "$result" != "0x2809f800 0x00000800" ]; then
+  printf '%s\n' "BK7258 SWAP layout mismatch: $result" >&2
+  exit 1
+fi

1: /****************************************************************************
2:  * BK7258 Mailbox V2 logical transport.
3:  ****************************************************************************/
4: 
5: #include <nuttx/config.h>
6: 
7: #include <errno.h>
8: #include <stdbool.h>
9: #include <stdint.h>
10: #include <stdio.h>
11: #include <string.h>
12: 
13: #include <nuttx/clock.h>
14: #include <nuttx/irq.h>
15: #include <nuttx/kthread.h>
16: #include <nuttx/semaphore.h>
17: #include <nuttx/signal.h>
18: 
19: #include "hardware/bk7258_mbox.h"
20: 
21: #define MB_CHANNEL_COUNT       3u
22: #define MB_ACK_SLOT_COUNT      8u
23: #define MB_ACK_HIGH_WATER      3u
24: #define MB_TIMEOUT             MSEC2TICK(200)
25: #define MB_WORK_INTERVAL       MSEC2TICK(10)
26: 
27: enum ack_slot_state
28: {
29:   ACK_SLOT_FREE = 0,
30:   ACK_SLOT_QUEUED,
31:   ACK_SLOT_SENT
32: };
33: 
34: struct logical_channel
35: {
36:   struct bk7258_mb_wire_message pending;
37:   bk7258_mb_tx_complete_t callback;
38:   void *arg;
39:   int result;
40:   bool queued;
41: };
42: 
43: struct active_transaction
44: {
45:   struct bk7258_mb_wire_message message __attribute__((aligned(32)));
46:   bk7258_mb_tx_complete_t callback;
47:   void *arg;
48:   clock_t started;
49:   uint32_t order;
50:   uint8_t channel_index;
51:   bool busy;
52:   bool quarantine;
53: };
54: 
55: struct ack_slot
56: {
57:   struct bk7258_mb_wire_message message __attribute__((aligned(32)));
58:   uint32_t order;
59:   enum ack_slot_state state;
60: };
61: 
62: struct transport_stats
63: {
64:   uint32_t tx;
65:   uint32_t rx;
66:   uint32_t fifo_full;
67:   uint32_t timeout;
68:   uint32_t bad_ack;
69:   uint32_t bad_header;
70:   uint32_t unsupported;
71:   uint32_t ack_overflow;
72:   uint32_t resets;
73:   uint32_t probes;
74:   uint32_t probe_fail;
75: };
76: 
77: static const uint8_t g_channel_ids[MB_CHANNEL_COUNT] =
78: {
79:   BK7258_MB_CHAN_HW_CTRL_TX,
80:   BK7258_MB_CHAN_PWC_TX,
81:   BK7258_MB_CHAN_UART0_TX
82: };
83: 
84: static struct logical_channel g_channels[MB_CHANNEL_COUNT];
85: static struct active_transaction g_active;
86: static struct active_transaction g_probe;
87: static struct ack_slot g_ack_slots[MB_ACK_SLOT_COUNT];
88: static struct bk7258_mb_wire_message g_reset_slot
89:   __attribute__((aligned(32)));
90: static struct transport_stats g_stats;
91: static bk7258_mb_channel_rx_t g_uart_rx;
92: static void *g_uart_rx_arg;
93: static void (*g_pwc_rx)(const void *message);
94: static bk7258_mb_link_callback_t g_link_callback;
95: static void *g_link_arg;
96: static sem_t g_tx_sem;
97: static uint32_t g_send_order;
98: static uint8_t g_tx_seq;
99: static enum bk7258_mb_link_state g_link_state;
100: static enum bk7258_mb_link_state g_reported_state;
101: static bool g_initialized;
102: static bool g_reset_pending;
103: static bool g_reset_sent;
104: static bool g_probe_requested;
105: 
106: static unsigned int channel_index(uint8_t channel)
107: {
108:   unsigned int i;
109: 
110:   for (i = 0; i < MB_CHANNEL_COUNT; i++)
111:     {
112:       if (g_channel_ids[i] == channel)
113:         {
114:           return i;
115:         }
116:     }
117: 
118:   return MB_CHANNEL_COUNT;
119: }
120: 
121: static unsigned int ack_slots_used(void)
122: {
123:   unsigned int count = 0;
124:   unsigned int i;
125: 
126:   for (i = 0; i < MB_ACK_SLOT_COUNT; i++)
127:     {
128:       if (g_ack_slots[i].state != ACK_SLOT_FREE)
129:         {
130:           count++;
131:         }
132:     }
133: 
134:   return count;
135: }
136: 
137: static bool transport_rx_ready(void)
138: {
139:   irqstate_t flags;
140:   bool ready;
141: 
142:   flags = up_irq_save();
143:   ready = ack_slots_used() < MB_ACK_SLOT_COUNT;
144:   up_irq_restore(flags);
145:   return ready;
146: }

148: static int send_slot(struct bk7258_mb_wire_message *message,
149:                      uint32_t *order)
150: {
151:   uint32_t wire[2];
152:   int ret;
153: 
154:   wire[0] = (uint32_t)(uintptr_t)message;
155:   wire[1] = sizeof(*message);
156:   __asm__ volatile("dmb sy" ::: "memory");
157:   ret = bk7258_mbox_send(0, wire);
158:   if (ret == OK)
159:     {
160:       *order = ++g_send_order;
161:       g_stats.tx++;
162:     }
163:   else if (ret == -EAGAIN)
164:     {
165:       g_stats.fifo_full++;
166:     }
167: 
168:   return ret;
169: }
170: 
171: static void release_acks_before(uint32_t order)
172: {
173:   unsigned int i;
174: 
175:   for (i = 0; i < MB_ACK_SLOT_COUNT; i++)
176:     {
177:       if (g_ack_slots[i].state == ACK_SLOT_SENT &&
178:           g_ack_slots[i].order < order)
179:         {
180:           g_ack_slots[i].state = ACK_SLOT_FREE;
181:         }
182:     }
183: }
184: 
185: static void set_link_state(enum bk7258_mb_link_state state)
186: {
187:   if (g_link_state != state)
188:     {
189:       g_link_state = state;
190:       nxsem_post(&g_tx_sem);
191:     }
192: }
193: 
194: static void complete_transaction(struct active_transaction *active,
195:                                  const struct bk7258_mb_wire_message *ack,
196:                                  int result)
197: {
198:   struct logical_channel *channel = NULL;
199: 
200:   if (active->channel_index < MB_CHANNEL_COUNT)
201:     {
202:       channel = &g_channels[active->channel_index];
203:       channel->queued = false;
204:       channel->result = result;
205:     }
206: 
207:   if (active->callback != NULL)
208:     {
209:       active->callback(ack, result, active->arg);
210:     }
211: 
212:   active->busy = false;
213:   if (result == OK)
214:     {
215:       release_acks_before(active->order);
216:     }
217: }
218: 
219: static void fail_pending(int result)
220: {
221:   unsigned int i;
222: 
223:   for (i = 0; i < MB_CHANNEL_COUNT; i++)
224:     {
225:       struct logical_channel *channel = &g_channels[i];
226: 
227:       if (channel->queued)
228:         {
229:           channel->queued = false;
230:           channel->result = result;
231:           if (channel->callback != NULL)
232:             {
233:               channel->callback(NULL, result, channel->arg);
234:             }
235:         }
236:     }
237: }
238: 
239: static void begin_abort(int result)
240: {
241:   if (g_active.busy)
242:     {
243:       g_active.quarantine = true;
244:       complete_transaction(&g_active, NULL, result);
245:     }
246: 
247:   if (g_probe.busy)
248:     {
249:       g_probe.quarantine = true;
250:       complete_transaction(&g_probe, NULL, result);
251:     }
252: 
253:   fail_pending(result);
254:   g_reset_pending = true;
255:   g_reset_sent = false;
256:   g_probe_requested = false;
257:   set_link_state(BK7258_MB_LINK_ABORTING);
258: }
259: 
260: static struct ack_slot *alloc_ack_slot(void)
261: {
262:   unsigned int i;
263: 
264:   for (i = 0; i < MB_ACK_SLOT_COUNT; i++)
265:     {
266:       if (g_ack_slots[i].state == ACK_SLOT_FREE)
267:         {
268:           g_ack_slots[i].state = ACK_SLOT_QUEUED;
269:           return &g_ack_slots[i];
270:         }
271:     }
272: 
273:   g_stats.ack_overflow++;
274:   return NULL;
275: }
276: 
277: static int dispatch_locked(void)
278: {
279:   struct active_transaction *active;
280:   struct logical_channel *channel;
281:   unsigned int i;
282:   int ret;
283: 
284:   /* ACKs always outrank RESET and ordinary commands. */
285: 
286:   for (i = 0; i < MB_ACK_SLOT_COUNT; i++)
287:     {
288:       if (g_ack_slots[i].state != ACK_SLOT_QUEUED)
289:         {
290:           continue;
291:         }
292: 
293:       ret = send_slot(&g_ack_slots[i].message, &g_ack_slots[i].order);
294:       if (ret < 0)
295:         {
296:           return ret;
297:         }
298: 
299:       g_ack_slots[i].state = ACK_SLOT_SENT;
300:     }
301: 
302:   if (g_reset_pending)
303:     {
304:       uint32_t order;
305: 
306:       ret = send_slot(&g_reset_slot, &order);
307:       if (ret < 0)
308:         {
309:           return ret;
310:         }
311: 
312:       g_reset_pending = false;
313:       g_reset_sent = true;
314:       set_link_state(BK7258_MB_LINK_PROBING);
315:     }
316: 
317:   if (g_active.busy || g_probe.busy)
318:     {
319:       return OK;
320:     }
321: 
322:   for (i = 0; i < MB_CHANNEL_COUNT; i++)
323:     {
324:       channel = &g_channels[i];
325:       if (!channel->queued)
326:         {
327:           continue;
328:         }
329: 
330:       if (g_link_state == BK7258_MB_LINK_PROBING)
331:         {
332:           if (g_channel_ids[i] != BK7258_MB_CHAN_UART0_TX ||
333:               bk7258_mb_header_cmd(&channel->pending) !=
334:               BK7258_MB_UART_STATE)
335:             {
336:               continue;
337:             }
338: 
339:           active = &g_probe;
340:           if (active->quarantine)
341:             {
342:               return -ENOLINK;
343:             }
344:         }
345:       else if (g_link_state == BK7258_MB_LINK_READY)
346:         {
347:           active = &g_active;
348:           if (active->quarantine)
349:             {
350:               return -ENOLINK;
351:             }
352:         }
353:       else
354:         {
355:           return OK;
356:         }
357: 
358:       memset(&active->message, 0, sizeof(active->message));
359:       memcpy(&active->message, &channel->pending, sizeof(active->message));
360:       active->message.header = bk7258_mb_make_header(
361:         bk7258_mb_header_cmd(&channel->pending),
362:         bk7258_mb_header_state(&channel->pending), 0, ++g_tx_seq,
363:         g_channel_ids[i]);
364:       active->callback = channel->callback;
365:       active->arg = channel->arg;
366:       active->channel_index = i;
367:       active->started = clock_systime_ticks();
368:       ret = send_slot(&active->message, &active->order);
369:       if (ret < 0)
370:         {
371:           return ret;
372:         }
373: 
374:       active->busy = true;
375:       if (active == &g_probe)
376:         {
377:           g_stats.probes++;
378:         }
379: 
380:       return OK;
381:     }
382: 
383:   return OK;
384: }
385: 
386: static bool valid_ack_header(const struct bk7258_mb_wire_message *message,
387:                              const struct active_transaction *active)
388: {
389:   uint8_t control = bk7258_mb_header_ctrl(message);
390: 
391:   return active->busy && control == BK7258_MB_CTRL_ACK_BOX &&
392:          bk7258_mb_header_channel(message) ==
393:            bk7258_mb_header_channel(&active->message) &&
394:          bk7258_mb_header_seq(message) ==
395:            bk7258_mb_header_seq(&active->message) &&
396:          bk7258_mb_header_cmd(message) ==
397:            bk7258_mb_header_cmd(&active->message);
398: }
399: 
400: static void handle_ack(const struct bk7258_mb_wire_message *message)
401: {
402:   struct active_transaction *active;
403:   int result;
404: 
405:   active = g_probe.busy ? &g_probe : &g_active;
406:   if (!valid_ack_header(message, active))
407:     {
408:       g_stats.bad_ack++;
409:       return;
410:     }
411: 
412:   result = (bk7258_mb_header_state(message) & BK7258_MB_STATE_COM_FAIL) != 0 ?
413:            -EREMOTEIO : OK;
414:   complete_transaction(active, message, result);
415: 
416:   if (active == &g_probe)
417:     {
418:       if (result == OK && (message->flags & 2u) == 0)
419:         {
420:           g_active.quarantine = false;
421:           g_probe.quarantine = false;
422:           g_reset_sent = false;
423:           set_link_state(BK7258_MB_LINK_READY);
424:         }
425:       else
426:         {
427:           g_stats.probe_fail++;
428:           set_link_state(BK7258_MB_LINK_DOWN);
429:         }
430:     }
431: 
432:   (void)dispatch_locked();
433: }
434: 
435: static void handle_command(const struct bk7258_mb_wire_message *message)
436: {
437:   struct ack_slot *slot;
438:   uint8_t channel = bk7258_mb_header_channel(message);
439:   uint8_t control = bk7258_mb_header_ctrl(message);
440:   uint8_t ack_flags = 0;
441:   uint8_t state = 0;
442:   int ret = -ENOSYS;
443: 
444:   if ((control & ~(BK7258_MB_CTRL_SYNC_TX | BK7258_MB_CTRL_RESET)) != 0 ||
445:       (channel & 0xf0u) != 0x40u)
446:     {
447:       g_stats.bad_header++;
448:       state = BK7258_MB_STATE_COM_FAIL;
449:     }
450:   else if (channel == BK7258_MB_CHAN_UART0_RX && g_uart_rx != NULL)
451:     {
452:       ret = g_uart_rx(message, &ack_flags, g_uart_rx_arg);
453:       if (ret < 0)
454:         {
455:           state = BK7258_MB_STATE_COM_FAIL;
456:         }
457:     }
458:   else if (channel == BK7258_MB_CHAN_PWC_RX && g_pwc_rx != NULL)
459:     {
460:       g_pwc_rx(message);
461:       ret = OK;
462:     }
463:   else
464:     {
465:       g_stats.unsupported++;
466:       state = BK7258_MB_STATE_COM_FAIL;
467:     }
468: 
469:   if ((control & BK7258_MB_CTRL_SYNC_TX) != 0)
470:     {
471:       return;
472:     }
473: 
474:   slot = alloc_ack_slot();
475:   if (slot == NULL)
476:     {
477:       return;
478:     }
479: 
480:   memset(&slot->message, 0, sizeof(slot->message));
481:   slot->message.header = bk7258_mb_make_header(
482:     bk7258_mb_header_cmd(message), state, BK7258_MB_CTRL_ACK_BOX,
483:     bk7258_mb_header_seq(message), channel);
484:   slot->message.payload_address = ack_flags;
485: 
486:   if (ack_slots_used() >= MB_ACK_HIGH_WATER)
487:     {
488:       g_probe_requested = true;
489:     }
490: 
491:   (void)dispatch_locked();
492: }

494: static void mailbox_rx(const struct bk7258_mb_wire_message *message)
495: {
496:   irqstate_t flags;
497:   uint8_t control;
498: 
499:   flags = up_irq_save();
500:   g_stats.rx++;
501:   control = bk7258_mb_header_ctrl(message);
502: 
503:   if ((control & BK7258_MB_CTRL_RESET) != 0)
504:     {
505:       if ((control & BK7258_MB_CTRL_ACK_BOX) == 0 ||
506:           (control & ~(BK7258_MB_CTRL_ACK_BOX | BK7258_MB_CTRL_RESET)) != 0)
507:         {
508:           g_stats.bad_header++;
509:         }
510:       else
511:         {
512:           g_stats.resets++;
513:           begin_abort(-ECONNRESET);
514:         }
515:     }
516:   else if ((control & BK7258_MB_CTRL_ACK_BOX) != 0)
517:     {
518:       handle_ack(message);
519:     }
520:   else
521:     {
522:       handle_command(message);
523:     }
524: 
525:   up_irq_restore(flags);
526:   nxsem_post(&g_tx_sem);
527: }

529: static int mailbox_tx_worker(int argc, char **argv)
530: {
531:   (void)argc;
532:   (void)argv;
533: 
534:   for (;;)
535:     {
536:       irqstate_t flags;
537:       bool request_probe;
538: 
539:       (void)nxsem_tickwait_uninterruptible(&g_tx_sem, MB_WORK_INTERVAL);
540:       flags = up_irq_save();
541: 
542:       if ((g_active.busy &&
543:            clock_systime_ticks() - g_active.started >= MB_TIMEOUT) ||
544:           (g_probe.busy &&
545:            clock_systime_ticks() - g_probe.started >= MB_TIMEOUT))
546:         {
547:           g_stats.timeout++;
548:           if (g_probe.busy)
549:             {
550:               g_probe.quarantine = true;
551:               complete_transaction(&g_probe, NULL, -ETIMEDOUT);
552:               g_stats.probe_fail++;
553:               set_link_state(BK7258_MB_LINK_DOWN);
554:             }
555:           else
556:             {
557:               begin_abort(-ETIMEDOUT);
558:             }
559:         }
560: 
561:       (void)dispatch_locked();
562:       request_probe = g_probe_requested &&
563:                       g_link_state == BK7258_MB_LINK_READY &&
564:                       !g_channels[2].queued && !g_active.busy;
565:       if (request_probe)
566:         {
567:           g_probe_requested = false;
568:         }
569: 
570:       if (g_reported_state != g_link_state)
571:         {
572:           enum bk7258_mb_link_state state = g_link_state;
573: 
574:           g_reported_state = state;
575:           up_irq_restore(flags);
576:           printf("mailbox: link %s\n",
577:                  state == BK7258_MB_LINK_READY ? "READY" :
578:                  state == BK7258_MB_LINK_PROBING ? "PROBING" :
579:                  state == BK7258_MB_LINK_ABORTING ? "ABORTING" : "DOWN");
580:           if (g_link_callback != NULL)
581:             {
582:               g_link_callback(state, g_link_arg);
583:             }
584: 
585:           flags = up_irq_save();
586:         }
587: 
588:       up_irq_restore(flags);
589: 
590:       if (request_probe)
591:         {
592:           bk7258_mb_uart_start();
593:         }
594:     }
595: 
596:   return OK;
597: }

599: int bk7258_mailbox_init(void)
600: {
601:   int ret;
602: 
603:   if (g_initialized)
604:     {
605:       return OK;
606:     }
607: 
608:   memset(g_channels, 0, sizeof(g_channels));
609:   memset(&g_active, 0, sizeof(g_active));
610:   memset(&g_probe, 0, sizeof(g_probe));
611:   memset(g_ack_slots, 0, sizeof(g_ack_slots));
612:   memset(&g_reset_slot, 0, sizeof(g_reset_slot));
613:   memset(&g_stats, 0, sizeof(g_stats));
614:   g_reset_slot.header = bk7258_mb_make_header(
615:     0, 0, BK7258_MB_CTRL_ACK_BOX | BK7258_MB_CTRL_RESET, 0,
616:     BK7258_MB_CHAN_HW_CTRL_TX);
617:   g_link_state = BK7258_MB_LINK_DOWN;
618:   g_reported_state = BK7258_MB_LINK_QUIESCING;
619:   nxsem_init(&g_tx_sem, 0, 0);
620:   bk7258_mbox_set_callback(mailbox_rx, transport_rx_ready);
621: 
622:   ret = bk7258_mbox_init();
623:   if (ret < 0)
624:     {
625:       return ret;
626:     }
627: 
628:   ret = kthread_create("mbox-v2", 105, 2048, mailbox_tx_worker, NULL);
629:   if (ret < 0)
630:     {
631:       return ret;
632:     }
633: 
634:   g_initialized = true;
635:   printf("mailbox: MBOX0 V2 initialized, ACK slots=%u\n",
636:          MB_ACK_SLOT_COUNT);
637:   return OK;
638: }

640: int bk7258_mailbox_send_wire(uint8_t logical_channel,
641:                              const struct bk7258_mb_wire_message *message,
642:                              bk7258_mb_tx_complete_t callback, void *arg)
643: {
644:   struct logical_channel *channel;
645:   unsigned int index;
646:   irqstate_t flags;
647:   int ret;
648: 
649:   if (!g_initialized || message == NULL)
650:     {
651:       return -EAGAIN;
652:     }
653: 
654:   index = channel_index(logical_channel);
655:   if (index >= MB_CHANNEL_COUNT)
656:     {
657:       return -EINVAL;
658:     }
659: 
660:   flags = up_irq_save();
661:   channel = &g_channels[index];
662:   if (channel->queued)
663:     {
664:       up_irq_restore(flags);
665:       return -EBUSY;
666:     }
667: 
668:   if (g_link_state != BK7258_MB_LINK_READY &&
669:       !(g_link_state == BK7258_MB_LINK_PROBING &&
670:         logical_channel == BK7258_MB_CHAN_UART0_TX &&
671:         bk7258_mb_header_cmd(message) == BK7258_MB_UART_STATE))
672:     {
673:       up_irq_restore(flags);
674:       return -ENOLINK;
675:     }
676: 
677:   memset(&channel->pending, 0, sizeof(channel->pending));
678:   memcpy(&channel->pending, message, sizeof(channel->pending));
679:   channel->callback = callback;
680:   channel->arg = arg;
681:   channel->result = -EINPROGRESS;
682:   channel->queued = true;
683:   ret = dispatch_locked();
684:   up_irq_restore(flags);
685:   nxsem_post(&g_tx_sem);
686:   return ret == -EAGAIN ? OK : ret;
687: }
688: 
689: int bk7258_mailbox_register_rx(uint8_t logical_channel,
690:                                bk7258_mb_channel_rx_t callback, void *arg)
691: {
692:   if (logical_channel != BK7258_MB_CHAN_UART0_RX)
693:     {
694:       return -EINVAL;
695:     }
696: 
697:   g_uart_rx = callback;
698:   g_uart_rx_arg = arg;
699:   return OK;
700: }

702: int bk7258_mailbox_start_probe(void)
703: {
704:   irqstate_t flags;
705: 
706:   if (!g_initialized)
707:     {
708:       return -EAGAIN;
709:     }
710: 
711:   flags = up_irq_save();

72:             }

75:               sent = dev->xmit.size - dev->xmit.tail;
76:             }

**关键设计**
- 固化显式 16 字节 little-endian wire ABI，包含 mask/shift、offset/size `_Static_assert`、SWAP/CP RAM/TX/RX 地址常量。
- MBOX0 不再初始化盲 drain；IRQ79 循环 drain，校验 SID、长度、4 字节对齐、地址溢出和 CP RAM 范围，并统计/W1C 清除 `wrerr/rderr/wrfull`。
- transport 使用独立 pending、active、probe、RESET 和 8 个 ACK 稳定槽；ACK 完整匹配 channel、sequence、command 和 header 合法性。
- 调度优先级为 ACK、RESET、HW_CTRL、PWC、UART0。
- 实现 `DOWN/ABORTING/PROBING/READY/QUIESCING` 状态、200 ms timeout、RESET、最多 3 次 STATE probe 和 quarantine 所有权规则。
- 不再写回 CP envelope；所有响应使用 AP-owned ACK slot。
- MBUART 固定使用 TX `0x2809fd00`、RX `0x2809fc00`，实现 DATA/STATE、8192 字节 TX ring、256 字节 RX capacity、整包校验/复制、RTS/CTS、75/25 upper-half flow control、统计和准确短写。
- DATA TX ring 只在成功 ACK 后推进；未知消费状态的超时 chunk 不重放，记录 `tx_unknown`。
- serial 实现完整 RX/TX/bulk/flow-control ops，注册 `/dev/console` 和 `/dev/ttyMB0`；移除 `/dev/ttyS1`、UART1 console 配置和 GPIO0/1 UART 宏。
- `arm_serialinit()` 先建立 transport、ACK资源、MBUART callback/worker，再开启 physical IRQ、发送 RESET/STATE，最后注册设备。
- bringup 不重复初始化，等待 link READY 后才继续 IPC power-up、PWC 和 PSRAM时序。
- syslog 按 `size_t` 分片并返回真实短写；force/flush 最多等待 20 ms，ISR 中不等待；lowputc 仅 best effort。
- linker 增加独立 2 KiB SWAP `NOLOAD`、地址/大小/heap assert；CSV 校验脚本同时接入 Make/CMake。
- MPU 增加 CP RAM RO/XN、UART RX RO/XN、UART TX RW/XN 精确 region；启动读取 `MPU_TYPE.DREGION`，不足时记录错误并拒绝继续启动。

42:                                  MBOX_CFG_WRFULL_STATUS)

49:   struct bk7258_mb_wire_message message;

65: static void mbox_clear_errors(void)
66: {
67:   uint32_t config = getreg32(MBOX_CH1_CFG);
68:   uint32_t errors = config & MBOX_CFG_ERROR_STATUS;
69: 
70:   if ((errors & MBOX_CFG_WRERR_STATUS) != 0)
71:     {
72:       g_stats.write_error++;
73:     }
74: 
75:   if ((errors & MBOX_CFG_RDERR_STATUS) != 0)
76:     {
77:       g_stats.read_error++;
78:     }
79: 
80:   if ((errors & MBOX_CFG_WRFULL_STATUS) != 0)
81:     {
82:       g_stats.write_full++;
83:     }

92:                                 uint32_t length)

94:   if (source != 0)
95:     {
96:       g_stats.bad_source++;
97:       return false;
98:     }
99: 
100:   if (length != BK7258_MB_MESSAGE_SIZE)
101:     {
102:       g_stats.bad_length++;
103:       return false;
104:     }
105: 
106:   if ((address & 3u) != 0 || address < BK7258_CP_RAM_START ||
107:       address > BK7258_CP_RAM_END - BK7258_MB_MESSAGE_SIZE)
108:     {
109:       g_stats.bad_address++;
110:       return false;
111:     }
112: 
113:   return true;

116: int bk7258_mbox_send(uint8_t destination, const uint32_t data[2])
117: {
118:   uintptr_t status;
119: 
120:   if (!g_mbox_ready || destination > 2 || data == NULL)
121:     {
122:       return -EINVAL;
123:     }
124: 
125:   /* CPU1 transmits through channel 1.  Full is reported by the target's
126:    * receive FIFO status register.
127:    */
128: 
129:   status = destination == 0 ? MBOX_CH0_STATUS : MBOX_CH1_STATUS;
130:   if ((getreg32(status) & 1u) != 0)
131:     {
132:       return -EAGAIN;
133:     }
134: 
135:   putreg32(data[0], MBOX_CH1_TDATA0);
136:   putreg32(data[1], MBOX_CH1_TDATA1);
137:   putreg32(destination, MBOX_CH1_TID);
138:   return OK;
139: }

143:   return (uint8_t)((g_rx_head + 1u) % MBOX_RX_DESC_COUNT) == g_rx_tail;
144: }

146: static int bk7258_mbox_irq(int irq, void *context, void *arg)
147: {
148:   (void)irq;
149:   (void)context;
150:   (void)arg;
151: 
152:   mbox_clear_errors();
153: 
154:   while ((bk7258_mbox_rx_status() & 2u) == 0)
155:     {
156:       struct mbox_rx_descriptor *desc;
157:       uint32_t address;
158:       uint32_t length;
159:       uint8_t source;
160: 
161:       /* Do not pop a valid command unless the logical layer can preserve
162:        * the response in an AP-owned ACK slot.
163:        */
164: 
165:       if (mbox_desc_full() || (g_rx_ready != NULL && !g_rx_ready()))
166:         {
167:           break;
168:         }
169: 
170:       source = getreg32(MBOX_CH1_SID) & 0x0fu;
171:       address = getreg32(MBOX_CH1_RDATA0);
172:       length = getreg32(MBOX_CH1_RDATA1);
173:       if (!mbox_valid_envelope(source, address, length))
174:         {
175:           continue;
176:         }
177: 
178:       desc = &g_rx_desc[g_rx_head];
179:       __asm__ volatile("dmb sy" ::: "memory");
180:       memcpy(&desc->message, (const void *)(uintptr_t)address,
181:              sizeof(desc->message));
182:       g_rx_head = (g_rx_head + 1u) % MBOX_RX_DESC_COUNT;
183:       g_stats.rx_messages++;
184: 
185:       while (g_rx_tail != g_rx_head)
186:         {
187:           desc = &g_rx_desc[g_rx_tail];
188:           if (g_callback != NULL)
189:             {
190:               g_callback(&desc->message);
191:             }
192: 
193:           g_rx_tail = (g_rx_tail + 1u) % MBOX_RX_DESC_COUNT;
194:         }
195:     }
196: 
197:   return OK;
198: }

200: void bk7258_mbox_set_callback(bk7258_mbox_callback_t callback,
201:                               bk7258_mbox_rx_ready_t ready)
202: {
203:   g_callback = callback;
204:   g_rx_ready = ready;
205: }

212:     {
213:       return;
214:     }
215: 
216:   flags = up_irq_save();
217:   *stats = g_stats;
218:   up_irq_restore(flags);

221: int bk7258_mbox_init(void)

223:   int ret;
224: 
225:   if (g_mbox_ready)
226:     {
227:       return OK;
228:     }
229: 
230:   g_rx_head = 0;
231:   g_rx_tail = 0;
232:   memset(&g_stats, 0, sizeof(g_stats));
233: 
234:   /* CPU1 owns channel 1 and FIFO entries 2..4.  Install the callback and
235:    * descriptors before enabling the route; pre-existing FIFO entries are
236:    * then processed normally instead of being blindly discarded.
237:    */
238: 
239:   putreg32(2u | MBOX_CFG_INT_EN | MBOX_CFG_WRERR_EN |
240:            MBOX_CFG_RDERR_EN | MBOX_CFG_WRFULL_EN, MBOX_CH1_CFG);
241:   putreg32(1u | (3u << 1), MBOX_CH1_FIFO_CFG);
242:   modifyreg32(MBOX_CTRL, 0, 1u << 2);
243:   mbox_clear_errors();
244: 
245:   ret = irq_attach(BK7258_IRQ_MAILBOX, bk7258_mbox_irq, NULL);
246:   if (ret < 0)
247:     {
248:       return ret;
249:     }
250: 
251:   g_mbox_ready = true;
252:   modifyreg32(BK7258_CPU1_IRQ_EN1, 0, 1u << 31);
253:   up_enable_irq(BK7258_IRQ_MAILBOX);
254:   return OK;

202: 
203:   if (active->channel_index < MB_CHANNEL_COUNT)
204:     {
205:       channel = &g_channels[active->channel_index];
206:       channel->queued = false;
207:       channel->result = result;

253:       complete_transaction(&g_probe, NULL, result);

258:    * If another abort arrives meanwhile, keep its bytes stable and continue
259:    * probing instead of writing a second envelope for the same slot.
260:    */

275:         {

285: static int dispatch_locked(void)
286: {
287:   struct active_transaction *active;
288:   struct logical_channel *channel;
289:   unsigned int i;
290:   int ret;
291: 
292:   /* ACKs always outrank RESET and ordinary commands. */
293: 
294:   for (i = 0; i < MB_ACK_SLOT_COUNT; i++)
295:     {
296:       if (g_ack_slots[i].state != ACK_SLOT_QUEUED)
297:         {
298:           continue;
299:         }
300: 
301:       ret = send_slot(&g_ack_slots[i].message, &g_ack_slots[i].order);
302:       if (ret < 0)
303:         {
304:           return ret;
305:         }
306: 
307:       g_ack_slots[i].state = ACK_SLOT_SENT;
308:     }
309: 
310:   if (g_reset_pending)
311:     {

313: 
314:       ret = send_slot(&g_reset_slot, &order);
315:       if (ret < 0)

318:         }

322:       set_link_state(BK7258_MB_LINK_PROBING);
323:     }

325:   if (g_active.busy || g_probe.busy)
326:     {
327:       return OK;
328:     }
329: 
330:   for (i = 0; i < MB_CHANNEL_COUNT; i++)
331:     {
332:       channel = &g_channels[i];
333:       if (!channel->queued)
334:         {
335:           continue;
336:         }
337: 
338:       if (g_link_state == BK7258_MB_LINK_PROBING)
339:         {
340:           if (g_channel_ids[i] != BK7258_MB_CHAN_UART0_TX ||

345:             }

352:         }
353:       else if (g_link_state == BK7258_MB_LINK_READY)

359:             }

361:       else

364:         }

369:         bk7258_mb_header_cmd(&channel->pending),
370:         bk7258_mb_header_state(&channel->pending), 0, ++g_tx_seq,

380:         }

395: static bool valid_ack_header(const struct bk7258_mb_wire_message *message,
396:                              const struct active_transaction *active)
397: {
398:   uint8_t control = bk7258_mb_header_ctrl(message);
399: 
400:   return active->busy && control == BK7258_MB_CTRL_ACK_BOX &&
401:          bk7258_mb_header_channel(message) ==
402:            bk7258_mb_header_channel(&active->message) &&
403:          bk7258_mb_header_seq(message) ==
404:            bk7258_mb_header_seq(&active->message) &&
405:          bk7258_mb_header_cmd(message) ==
406:            bk7258_mb_header_cmd(&active->message);

409: static bool valid_uart_ack(const struct bk7258_mb_wire_message *message)
410: {
411:   return (message->payload_address & ~3u) == 0 &&
412:          message->payload_length == 0 && message->flags == 0 &&
413:          message->crc8 == 0 && message->reserved == 0;
414: }

416: static void handle_ack(const struct bk7258_mb_wire_message *message)
417: {
418:   struct active_transaction *active;
419:   int result;
420: 
421:   active = g_probe.busy ? &g_probe : &g_active;
422:   if (!valid_ack_header(message, active))
423:     {
424:       g_stats.bad_ack++;
425:       return;
426:     }
427: 
428:   if (bk7258_mb_header_channel(message) == BK7258_MB_CHAN_UART0_TX &&
429:       !valid_uart_ack(message))
430:     {
431:       /* Keep active stable.  A malformed ACK is not an ownership proof. */
432: 
433:       g_stats.bad_ack++;
434:       return;
435:     }
436: 
437:   if ((bk7258_mb_header_state(message) & ~BK7258_MB_STATE_COM_FAIL) != 0)
438:     {
439:       g_stats.bad_ack++;
440:       return;
441:     }
442: 
443:   result = (bk7258_mb_header_state(message) & BK7258_MB_STATE_COM_FAIL) != 0 ?
444:            -EREMOTEIO : OK;
445: 
446:   if (bk7258_mb_header_channel(message) == BK7258_MB_CHAN_UART0_TX &&
447:       result == OK && (message->payload_address & 2u) != 0)
448:     {
449:       result = -EREMOTEIO;
450:     }
451: 
452:   release_acks_before(active->order);
453: 
454:   complete_transaction(active, message, result);
455: 
456:   if (active == &g_probe)
457:     {
458:       if (result == OK && (message->flags & 2u) == 0)
459:         {
460:           g_active.quarantine = false;
461:           g_probe.quarantine = false;
462:           g_reset_sent = false;
463:           g_probe_attempts = 0;
464:           set_link_state(BK7258_MB_LINK_READY);
465:         }
466:       else if (result == -EREMOTEIO &&
467:                g_probe_attempts < MB_PROBE_MAX_ATTEMPTS)
468:         {
469:           /* CP may not have opened MB_UART0 yet.  The matched ACK proves
470:            * that this probe slot is no longer referenced by its FIFO.
471:            */
472:         }
473:       else
474:         {
475:           g_stats.probe_fail++;
476:           g_probe.quarantine = result == -ETIMEDOUT;
477:           set_link_state(BK7258_MB_LINK_DOWN);
478:         }
479:     }
480: 
481:   else if (bk7258_mb_header_channel(message) == BK7258_MB_CHAN_UART0_TX &&

490: static void handle_command(const struct bk7258_mb_wire_message *message)
491: {
492:   struct ack_slot *slot;
493:   uint8_t channel = bk7258_mb_header_channel(message);
494:   uint8_t control = bk7258_mb_header_ctrl(message);
495:   uint8_t ack_flags = 0;
496:   uint8_t state = 0;
497:   int ret = -ENOSYS;
498: 
499:   if ((control & ~(BK7258_MB_CTRL_SYNC_TX | BK7258_MB_CTRL_RESET)) != 0 ||
500:       bk7258_mb_header_state(message) != 0 ||
501:       (channel & 0xf0u) != 0x40u)
502:     {
503:       g_stats.bad_header++;
504:       state = BK7258_MB_STATE_COM_FAIL;
505:     }
506:   else if (channel == BK7258_MB_CHAN_UART0_RX && g_uart_rx != NULL)
507:     {
508:       ret = g_uart_rx(message, &ack_flags, g_uart_rx_arg);
509:       if (ret < 0)
510:         {
511:           state = BK7258_MB_STATE_COM_FAIL;
512:         }
513:     }
514:   else if (channel == BK7258_MB_CHAN_PWC_RX && g_pwc_rx != NULL)
515:     {
516:       g_pwc_rx(message);
517:       ret = OK;
518:     }
519:   else
520:     {
521:       g_stats.unsupported++;
522:       state = BK7258_MB_STATE_COM_FAIL;
523:     }
524: 
525:   if ((control & BK7258_MB_CTRL_SYNC_TX) != 0)
526:     {
527:       return;
528:     }
529: 
530:   slot = alloc_ack_slot();
531:   if (slot == NULL)
532:     {
533:       return;
534:     }
535: 
536:   memset(&slot->message, 0, sizeof(slot->message));
537:   slot->message.header = bk7258_mb_make_header(
538:     bk7258_mb_header_cmd(message), state, BK7258_MB_CTRL_ACK_BOX,
539:     bk7258_mb_header_seq(message), channel);
540:   slot->message.payload_address = ack_flags;
541: 
542:   if (ack_slots_used() >= MB_ACK_HIGH_WATER)
543:     {
544:       g_probe_requested = true;
545:     }
546: 
547:   (void)dispatch_locked();
548: }

551: {

556:   g_stats.rx++;

559:   if ((control & BK7258_MB_CTRL_RESET) != 0)
560:     {
561:       if ((control & BK7258_MB_CTRL_ACK_BOX) == 0 ||
562:           (bk7258_mb_header_channel(message) & 0xf0u) != 0x40u ||
563:           (control & ~(BK7258_MB_CTRL_ACK_BOX | BK7258_MB_CTRL_RESET)) != 0)
564:         {

566:         }
567:       else
568:         {

572:     }

577:   else

164:       g_uart.state_pending = true;
165:     }
166: 
167:   if (command == BK7258_MB_UART_DATA && g_uart.tx_inflight != 0)
168:     {
169:       if (!failed)
170:         {
171:           g_uart.tx_read = (g_uart.tx_read + g_uart.tx_inflight) %
172:                            MB_UART_TX_SIZE;
173:         }
174:       else
175:         {
176:           /* A failed/unknown ACK cannot tell whether CP consumed the bytes.
177:            * Drop this local chunk rather than replaying terminal characters.
178:            */
179: 
180:           g_uart.tx_read = (g_uart.tx_read + g_uart.tx_inflight) %
181:                            MB_UART_TX_SIZE;
182:           if (result == -ETIMEDOUT || result == -ECONNRESET)
183:             {
184:               g_uart.stats.tx_unknown++;
185:             }
186:           else
187:             {
188:               g_uart.stats.remote_fail++;
189:               g_uart.reset_pending = true;
190:             }
191:         }
192: 
193:       g_uart.tx_inflight = 0;
194:     }
195:   else if (command == BK7258_MB_UART_STATE && failed)
196:     {
197:       g_uart.stats.remote_fail++;
198:       if (bk7258_mailbox_link_state() == BK7258_MB_LINK_PROBING)
199:         {
200:           if (result == -EREMOTEIO)
201:             {
202:               g_uart.state_pending = true;
203:             }
204:         }
205:       else if (result != -ETIMEDOUT && result != -ECONNRESET)
206:         {
207:           g_uart.reset_pending = true;
208:         }
209:     }
210: 
211:   g_uart.transaction_busy = false;
212:   up_irq_restore(flags);
213:   nxsem_post(&g_uart.worker_sem);
214: }

216: static int mb_uart_receive(const struct bk7258_mb_wire_message *message,
217:                            uint8_t *ack_flags, void *arg)
218: {
219:   uint8_t command = bk7258_mb_header_cmd(message);
220:   uint16_t length = message->payload_length;
221:   uint16_t first;
222:   bool failed = false;
223:   bool malformed = false;
224: 
225:   (void)arg;
226:   if (ack_flags == NULL)
227:     {
228:       return -EINVAL;
229:     }
230: 
231:   if (command != BK7258_MB_UART_DATA && command != BK7258_MB_UART_STATE)
232:     {
233:       g_uart.stats.bad_flags++;
234:       failed = true;
235:       malformed = true;
236:     }
237:   else if ((message->flags & ~1u) != 0)
238:     {
239:       g_uart.stats.bad_flags++;
240:       failed = true;
241:       malformed = true;
242:     }
243:   else if (message->crc8 != 0)
244:     {
245:       g_uart.stats.bad_crc++;
246:       g_uart.sticky_status |= MB_UART_STATUS_PARITY;
247:       failed = true;
248:       malformed = true;
249:     }
250:   else if (message->reserved != 0)
251:     {
252:       g_uart.stats.bad_reserved++;
253:       failed = true;
254:       malformed = true;
255:     }
256: 
257:   if (!failed && command == BK7258_MB_UART_DATA)
258:     {
259:       if (message->payload_address != BK7258_MB_UART_RX_ADDRESS)
260:         {
261:           g_uart.stats.bad_pointer++;
262:           failed = true;
263:           malformed = true;
264:         }
265:       else if (length == 0 || length > BK7258_MB_UART_CHUNK_SIZE)
266:         {
267:           g_uart.stats.bad_length++;
268:           failed = true;
269:           malformed = true;
270:         }
271:       else if (!bk7258_mailbox_link_ready())
272:         {
273:           failed = true;
274:         }
275:       else if (rx_free() < length)
276:         {
277:           g_uart.stats.rx_overflow++;
278:           g_uart.sticky_status |= MB_UART_STATUS_OVF;
279:           failed = true;
280:         }
281:       else
282:         {
283:           const uint8_t *source =
284:             (const uint8_t *)(uintptr_t)BK7258_MB_UART_RX_ADDRESS;
285: 
286:           __asm__ volatile("dmb sy" ::: "memory");
287:           first = MB_UART_RX_SIZE - g_uart.rx_write;
288:           if (first > length)
289:             {
290:               first = length;
291:             }
292: 
293:           memcpy(&g_uart.rx_ring[g_uart.rx_write], source, first);
294:           if (first != length)
295:             {
296:               memcpy(g_uart.rx_ring, source + first, length - first);
297:             }
298: 
299:           g_uart.rx_write = (g_uart.rx_write + length) % MB_UART_RX_SIZE;
300:           g_uart.stats.data_rx++;
301:           g_uart.stats.rx_bytes += length;
302:         }
303:     }
304:   else if (!failed)
305:     {
306:       if (message->payload_address != 0 || message->payload_length != 0)
307:         {
308:           g_uart.stats.bad_length++;
309:           failed = true;
310:           malformed = true;
311:         }
312:       else
313:         {
314:           g_uart.stats.state_rx++;
315:         }
316:     }
317: 
318:   if (!malformed)
319:     {
320:       bool old_peer_rts = g_uart.peer_rts;
321: 
322:       g_uart.peer_rts = (message->flags & 1u) != 0;
323:       g_uart.peer_rts_known = true;
324:       if (old_peer_rts && !g_uart.peer_rts)
325:         {
326:           nxsem_post(&g_uart.worker_sem);
327:         }
328:     }
329: 
330:   update_local_rts();
331:   *ack_flags = (g_uart.local_rts ? 1u : 0u) | (failed ? 2u : 0u);
332:   nxsem_post(&g_uart.worker_sem);
333:   return malformed ? -EPROTO : OK;
334: }

336: static int send_state_locked(void)

338:   struct bk7258_mb_wire_message message;
339:   int ret;

365:   int ret;

367:   if (length > BK7258_MB_UART_CHUNK_SIZE)
368:     {
369:       length = BK7258_MB_UART_CHUNK_SIZE;
370:     }
371: 
372:   if (length == 0 || g_uart.peer_rts)

374:       return -EAGAIN;
375:     }

377:   first = MB_UART_TX_SIZE - g_uart.tx_read;
378:   if (first > length)
379:     {
380:       first = length;
381:     }
382: 
383:   memcpy(destination, &g_uart.tx_ring[g_uart.tx_read], first);
384:   if (first != length)
385:     {
386:       memcpy(destination + first, g_uart.tx_ring, length - first);
387:     }
388: 
389:   memset(&message, 0, sizeof(message));
390:   message.header = bk7258_mb_make_header(BK7258_MB_UART_DATA, 0, 0, 0,
391:                                          BK7258_MB_CHAN_UART0_TX);
392:   message.payload_address = BK7258_MB_UART_TX_ADDRESS;
393:   message.payload_length = length;
394:   message.flags = g_uart.local_rts ? 1u : 0u;
395:   __asm__ volatile("dmb sy" ::: "memory");
396:   ret = bk7258_mailbox_send_wire(BK7258_MB_CHAN_UART0_TX, &message,
397:                                   mb_uart_tx_complete, NULL);
398:   if (ret == OK)
399:     {
400:       g_uart.transaction_busy = true;
401:       g_uart.transaction_command = BK7258_MB_UART_DATA;
402:       g_uart.tx_inflight = length;
403:       g_uart.stats.data_tx++;
404:     }
405: 
406:   return ret;

409: static int mb_uart_worker(int argc, char **argv)
410: {
411:   (void)argc;
412:   (void)argv;
413: 
414:   for (;;)
415:     {
416:       irqstate_t flags;
417:       bool reset;
418: 
419:       (void)nxsem_tickwait_uninterruptible(&g_uart.worker_sem,
420:                                            MB_UART_WORK_INTERVAL);
421:       flags = up_irq_save();
422:       reset = g_uart.reset_pending;
423:       g_uart.reset_pending = false;
424: 
425:       if (!reset && !g_uart.transaction_busy)
426:         {
427:           enum bk7258_mb_link_state link = bk7258_mailbox_link_state();
428: 
429:           if (link == BK7258_MB_LINK_PROBING && g_uart.state_pending)
430:             {
431:               (void)send_state_locked();
432:             }
433:           else if (link == BK7258_MB_LINK_READY)
434:             {
435:               if (g_uart.state_pending)
436:                 {
437:                   (void)send_state_locked();
438:                 }
439:               else
440:                 {
441:                   (void)send_data_locked();
442:                 }
443:             }
444:         }
445: 
446:       up_irq_restore(flags);
447:       if (reset)
448:         {
449:           g_uart.stats.resets++;
450:           bk7258_mailbox_force_reset();
451:           flags = up_irq_save();
452:           g_uart.peer_rts_known = false;
453:           g_uart.state_pending = true;
454:           up_irq_restore(flags);
455:         }
456: 
457:       if (g_uart.callback != NULL)
458:         {
459:           g_uart.callback(g_uart.callback_arg);
460:         }
461:     }
462: 
463:   return OK;
464: }

1: #!/bin/sh
2: 
3: set -eu
4: 
5: script_dir=$(dirname "$(readlink -f "$0")")
6: csv=${1:-$script_dir/../../../../external/bk_avdk_smp/projects/app_ab/partitions/bk7258/ram_regions.csv}
7: 
8: if [ ! -r "$csv" ]; then
9:   printf '%s\n' "BK7258 SWAP layout: cannot read $csv" >&2
10:   exit 1
11: fi
12: 
13: result=$(awk -F, '
14:   function hex(value, result, i, digit) {
15:     sub(/^0[xX]/, "", value)
16:     value = tolower(value)
17:     result = 0
18:     for (i = 1; i <= length(value); i++) {
19:       digit = index("0123456789abcdef", substr(value, i, 1)) - 1
20:       if (digit < 0) return -1
21:       result = result * 16 + digit
22:     }
23:     return result
24:   }
25:   BEGIN { base = hex("28000000"); found = 0 }
26:   /^[[:space:]]*#/ { next }
27:   /^[[:space:]]*PSRAM_CAPCAITY_SIZE/ { next }
28:   NF >= 4 {
29:     name = $1
30:     type = $2
31:     offset = $3
32:     size = $4
33:     gsub(/[[:space:]]/, "", name)
34:     gsub(/[[:space:]]/, "", type)
35:     gsub(/[[:space:]]/, "", offset)
36:     gsub(/[[:space:]]/, "", size)
37:     if (type != "SRAM") next
38:     if (offset != "") base = hex(offset)
39:     bytes = hex(size)
40:     if (name == "SWAP") {
41:       printf "0x%08x 0x%08x\n", base, bytes
42:       found = 1
43:     }
44:     base += bytes
45:   }
46:   END { if (!found) exit 2 }
47: ' "$csv")
48: 
49: if [ "$result" != "0x2809f800 0x00000800" ]; then
50:   printf '%s\n' "BK7258 SWAP layout mismatch: $result" >&2
51:   exit 1
52: fi

已完成独立审查提出的 AP 侧 Critical/High/Medium 修复，并重新执行完整 `distclean + -Werror CMake` 构建。

**关键修复**
- **RX admission 与 ACK pool**
  - MBOX0 改为 7 个 AP-owned RX descriptor，足以容纳一个因 ACK 资源不足而延迟的普通 command，加上两个完整的 3-entry 硬件 FIFO 周期。
  - RX descriptor 按硬件接收顺序保存，ACK/RESET 分类为高优先级，可越过延迟普通 command 处理。
  - 普通 command 在没有 ACK slot 时返回 `-EAGAIN`，descriptor 保留且不执行应用回调，避免重复副作用和丢 ACK。
  - ACK pool 扩为 8 个稳定槽，并增加编译期断言：容量必须大于两个 3-entry FIFO 深度。
  - matching ACK 可释放在其发送顺序之前的 ACK slots，然后立即重试 deferred command。
  - 增加 `descriptor_full`、`descriptor_deferred`、`deferred_command` 和 ACK pool 使用量统计。
  - 相关实现：`board/beken/chips/bk7258/bk7258_mbox0.c:45`、`board/beken/chips/bk7258/bk7258_mailbox_channel.c:125`

- **有界恢复和稳定 recovery epoch**
  - 单一 probe/reset slot 改为 4 组独立稳定 recovery epoch，每组包含 RESET slot、STATE probe slot、发送顺序和 quarantine 状态。
  - timeout 后旧 epoch 不被覆盖；每 100 ms 启动下一组空闲 epoch，且每个新周期重置 probe attempts。
  - 所有 epoch 都被 quarantine 时，只重发最近稳定 probe，且不修改其 wire 内容。
  - replay ACK 仅证明其原始发送和更早 envelope 已被复制，不直接释放 replay slot；随后使用已释放 epoch 发送新序号 RESET/STATE confirmation。
  - 只有新 confirmation STATE 成功 ACK 后才释放 active、RESET、probe 和旧 epoch。
  - 增加 recovery cycle、replay、READY/DOWN 和 probe failure 统计。
  - 相关实现：`board/beken/chips/bk7258/bk7258_mailbox_channel.c:65`、`board/beken/chips/bk7258/bk7258_mailbox_channel.c:297`

- **DATA 明确失败语义**
  - 成功 ACK 才推进 TX ring。
  - timeout/reset 属于消费状态未知：丢弃该 chunk，记录 `tx_unknown`，不重放。
  - `COM_FAIL` 或 `uart_tx_fail` 属于明确未消费：保留 `tx_read`，STATE 恢复后最多重试一次。
  - 第二次明确失败才推进并丢弃，记录 `tx_retry_drop`；新增 `tx_retry` 统计。
  - 相关实现：`board/beken/chips/bk7258/bk7258_mb_uart.c:151`

- **日志与 ISR 安全**
  - transport worker 不再调用 `printf/syslog`。
  - 链路状态变化只发布轻量 semaphore 事件，由独立低优先级 `mbox-diag` 线程输出非阻塞 syslog 和执行 link callback。
  - MBOX ISR 不包含格式化日志、sleep 或阻塞等待。
  - ISR 使用的 `nxsem_post()` 均只唤醒 worker；ring 和 transport 状态仍由本地 IRQ critical section保护。
  - 相关实现：`board/beken/chips/bk7258/bk7258_mailbox_channel.c:748`

- **serial 注册和配置自洽**
  - 检查 `/dev/console` 与 `/dev/ttyMB0` 的 `uart_register()` 返回值并记录错误。
  - serial lower-half 数据和 callback 仅在 `CONFIG_BK7258_MB_UART0_CONSOLE` 下定义和注册。
  - Mailbox V2 保持 BK7258 AP 的内部必选 transport，Make/CMake 始终同步编译核心实现，避免关闭 console 后 PWC/HW_CTRL 出现未解析引用。
  - 相关实现：`board/beken/chips/bk7258/bk7258_serial.c:18`、`board/beken/chips/bk7258/bk7258_serial.c:219`

- **地址、ABI 和构建校验**
  - `bk7258_mbox_send()` 现在分别读取 CPU0、CPU1、CPU2 对应 destination FIFO status。
  - 新增 header mask 完整覆盖/无重叠、SWAP payload 范围和 32-byte alignment 编译期断言。
  - TX/RX ring 增加 `UINT16_MAX` 上界和 chunk 容量断言，当前 8192/257 配置安全。
  - SWAP 脚本同时核对：
    - authoritative `ram_regions.csv`
    - `hardware/bk7258_mbox.h`
    - board linker script
    - 可选 Armino generated `ram_regions.h`
  - 可通过第二个参数或 `BK7258_ARMINO_RAM_HEADER` 指定 generated header。
  - 相关实现：`board/beken/chips/bk7258/check_swap_layout.sh:5`、`board/beken/chips/bk7258/hardware/bk7258_mbox.h:20`

**死锁约束**
- 硬件 RX FIFO 深度为 3。
- ACK pool 有 8 个稳定 slot，可覆盖两个完整 FIFO 批次并保留余量。
- RX descriptor 有 7 个，可保存一个 deferred普通 command和随后两个完整 FIFO 批次。
- ACK/RESET 不消耗 ACK slot，因此即使 ACK pool 已满，也会进入 descriptor 并优先处理。
- matching ACK 释放旧 ACK slots后，deferred command立即获得 slot并继续。
- 如果没有 matching ACK，则 timeout 进入多 epoch RESET/STATE recovery，不依赖普通 command 推进链路。

**验证**
执行：

```bash
./build.sh vendor/beken/boards/bk7258/bk7258-ap/configs/nsh --cmake distclean

./build.sh \
  vendor/beken/boards/bk7258/bk7258-ap/configs/nsh \
  -e -Werror \
  --cmake \
  -j8
```
